properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret containing at least 32 bytes.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-token-expiration-days
properties.description: Refresh-token and refresh-cookie lifetime in days.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-cookie-name
properties.description: Name of the HttpOnly refresh-token cookie.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-cookie-secure
properties.description: Whether the refresh-token cookie is restricted to HTTPS.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-cookie-same-site
properties.description: SameSite policy for the refresh-token cookie.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-delimited list of trusted frontend origins.
